items.text: Heard the same
Only heard negatives about using paperlike tbh

Ok I understand your POV but if Apple drops its smart speaker isn’t that just giving up. Do you think they will just replace it? I think it’s a competitive market Apple could do well in given how tight the ecosystem is with a few tweaks to Siri
Can we control our TV via HomePod at all? I’m still learning how to make use of HomeKit and TV but last time I tried it said I didn’t have one set up even tho I own a 4K version.
One thing I love is how it hears you when you talk even over loud music. Makes it nice to use.
Is what your after what my my watch does? Notify me wherever I am? Also frees me from my phone when I’m home.
I had my phone like that for a bit when new til I got a case. It felt amazing. Now I use Apple leather case bc I can’t afford to fix it if I dropped it.
Are these the go to plugs now? I have been waiting to start my smart home. Any downsides to using these?
Impressive dedication. Now keep it up and enjoy
Keep it up!
This would have too many negatives to be worth it. Especially when you remove any big news topics they might want to discuss later in the week.

Your last line. Worrying. As someone who struggles with anxiety.... try not to. It does not help.

Focus on the positive dude.

“So happy”

I suggest you keep it up in that case.
Great perspective

I’m on day 1 myself. I’ve always drank but usually just casually.

I decided while I quit the green I’m allowing myself 1 bottle of beer a day to kind of mentally keep myself from going crazy but I’ve always had a good handle on booze bc it never did much for me. More of something that pairs well with some fish n chips or nachos etc.

Now seeing some people post they switched from green to cigs makes me a raise an eyebrow. I feel like I’d be back into the green doing that and than have 2 problems to deal with is the risk you run.
To no gore? That was an old game called Mortal Kombat vs DC comics
It is not easy to do. I’m on day 2 and the daily habit is hard to break out of.
Thanks. I needed this on a rough day 2

I always loved video games long before I used some weed. 

So I have been using the new DOOM to keep me happy these first 2 days and it has helped.

I also took up running and only found benefits from it before I quit but now I’m injured so it’s not an option. The timing on the injury sure doesn’t help but I have something to look forward to.

Go outside or stay inside just find something to do!

I’m on day 2. It’s been hard but I will use a quote I see long distance runners say a lot.

It always gets better. There is always a light. Keep it up and suddenly you are in that light.

When it’s the toughest I come here and read what people wrote. You have inspired me to make sure I don’t just smack day 2 down but 3 as well.

One day at a time and embrace the positive changes and clarity when it comes.

Believe me. I constantly fight the craving and wish I didn’t have weed in my house but I need it there to prove I can say no and have control.
Awesome. I woke up day 2 with no energy but I’m starting to get some now. A good meal certainly goes a long way.

2016. I never finished it so I’m finally getting back to it now to try to have some fun through this and the game stands up INCREDIBLY well on my PS4Pro. I love the gameplay loop they designed. Chainsaw to get ammo from an enemy is my type of game haha.

Eternal looks badass as well.
Yeah I quit PC stuff when my family happened so I am jealous. It’s actually remarkable how well it plays on PS4 tho. Those guys know good tight gameplay.
This is important and you should be commended for trying to relay this info to more people.
Grats on the achievement. Keep at it.

I’ve seen multiple people say they actually feel worse after smoking again. 

It’s def helped put me off caving knowing that.
I’m still struggling but reading your response has helped a bunch. It’s true, you think oh just smoke and it will be better but I know it wont and you help remind me that.
Yup I added a couple hours of video games to my day to fill my head with some fun stuff

I don’t have any of those issues I keep seeing mentioned but did before when I tried. I must have been smoking more than.

It sounds a lot harder with that shit but it seems even better reason to stop. 

Day 3 and I certainly needed this reminder to suck it up and march on, thanks

I was subbed to hotboxin with mike Tyson on YouTube and he had snoop dogg on. Yesterday rogan had BReal on.

I realized I need to cut these out of my daily bc they are not helping!

I had some pretty crazy dreams, but nothing scary.

But no, I’m not smoking today so I can keep feeling the positive benefits.
Honestly. You decided to quit again. That’s enough to tell me you got this.
Don’t over think it. I do and it’s a detriment. When I do I come on here to remind myself why I’m doing this.
Nice. I’m on day 4 and it’s all I think about when I’m home. Driving me crazy. 1 week is a nice number, stay strong

Yeah the highs aren’t as high, Aha, but they feel much more earned to me so far. It’s the anxiety that I used to smoke for that is driving me nuts. I was running before for relief but pulled my groin just before quitting so it’s not an option.

Stay strong!

It’s gets harder and easier everyday for me so far.

Harder because when I get more clear minded I think I can handle it better and it will feel good to smoke again. Rid me of my anxiety.

Easier because the positives like enjoying the fruits of my labor and the real life high I earn.

Being high all the time sucks. Just the truth.
Playing Doom 2016. Fun game. Slaying demons helps me haha
Sounds like a bad time. But idk that blaming him will help. He should support you tho.
That’s the thing about running. You don’t think you can than suddenly you have the energy. It’s why a lot of us run. Suddenly you can do more than you thought and your confidence goes way up.

If you have a weak moment, I find coming on here and simply reading helps. It’s OK if it gets tough. Your mind is a complicated thing, it’s pretty hard to avoid. Just try to have a plan on how you are going to tackle it,
Are you exercising?
Whatever makes you happy dude.
12 years is a long time. Wish you the best.
I agree with the other comment, get a good pair of shoes and get out the door,
